data.name: Argent
data.gender_notes: Argent is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin argentum, meaning silver. In Christian symbolism, silver represents purity and redemption. The name Argent carries the meaning “Silver” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Argent usually hope their child will grow to embody silver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Argent belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Silver.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Argent total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
